previous_exposure.pipeline: DataCamp score-oriented historical project, excluded from every baseline and comparison
previous_exposure.provenance: previous documented audit; not recomputed for this protocol

evaluation_population.admission: all valid registered matches, independent of score; verified 90 minutes where possible, final score otherwise
evaluation_population.same_date: calculate all features before updating any outcomes that day

primary_comparison.candidate: frozen logistic with Elo and form
primary_comparison.reference: frozen Solo Elo with fixed venue
primary_comparison.endpoint: pooled per-match log loss difference, logistic minus Elo
primary_comparison.confirmation_rule: upper paired 95% CI < 0, mean Brier difference <= 0, log loss improves in >=3/4 subperiods
primary_comparison.decision: confirm or fail to confirm selection; do not reselect, refit or change deployment weights from these outcomes

strata.non_friendlies: not Friendly; operational category, not certification of official status
strata.worldcup: FIFA World Cup, report N=0 if absent

strong_teams.rating: raw pre-match frozen-policy Elo, without venue bonus

strata.worldcup_48_mutual: both opponents in the fixed 48-team fixture list
strata.worldcup_48_any_opponent: at least one opponent in the fixed 48-team fixture list

sensitivities.exclude_marked: evaluate only rows without shootout or proven extra-time goals; no refitting; main frozen form state retains all history
sensitivities.non_friendlies: evaluate frozen models on non-friendlies; no training restricted to the evaluation period
sensitivities.strict_duration: verified independent catalogue only, descriptive when sample is absent or small
sensitivities.no_input_policy_switch: do not rebuild different form variables for the already frozen model

metrics.log_loss: natural log, clip observed outcome probability to [1e-15,1]
metrics.brier: sum of squared error across 3 classes, no division
metrics.rps: sum squared cumulative probability errors / 2; ordered away-win, draw, home-win
metrics.accuracy: argmax in home-win, draw, away-win order, deterministic tie rule
metrics.score_nll: joint infinite-support likelihood, count models only; unavailable for direct 1X2 classifiers
metrics.reliability: 10 fixed equal-width bins [0,1], counts, mean probability and observed fraction; empty bins explicit
metrics.ece: 10 fixed-bin ECE per class, supplementary only
metrics.calibration_intercept_slope: one-vs-rest binary unpenalized logistic diagnostic on logit(p), p clipped [1e-6,1-1e-6]; ideal intercept 0, slope 1; no correction applied to forecasts; failure or single-class strata reported unavailable

uncertainty.means: pool match sums/counts, not an unweighted average of quarters
uncertainty.secondary_comparisons: descriptive, no claim from an isolated significant comparator or stratum

product_separation.score_product: Poisson score matrix and its own derived 1X2
product_separation.discrepancy: mean over matches and 3 classes of absolute probability difference; report percentage points, per-class means and mean total variation

model_drift: model coefficients fixed since training before 2023; update only Elo/form state; report each subperiod, no recalibration or refitting
chronology: update causal state using only pre-2026-06-10 results
generate 72 fixed-cutoff group forecasts, score matrices and all comparator forecasts
validate probability mass and neutral symmetry to 1e-9, seal SHA256 and real UTC time
load official World Cup results only after prediction commit and seal
input_timing_clarification: pre-cutoff outcomes are necessary input BEFORE sealing the 72 forecasts; after approval, before evaluation; none of the World Cup outcomes are used in this state

worldcup_evaluation.small_sample: report actual uncertainty; do not hard-code a standard error or assert models are indistinguishable without calculating it
worldcup_evaluation.bootstrap: paired calendar-date blocks, 2000 replicates, seed 20261012; sensitivity by match, report clustering limits and actual N
worldcup_evaluation.knockouts: separate, 90 minutes only, if available and verifiable; no automatic shootout-to-draw

time_authority: Git commit timestamps and timestamped hash seals; never filesystem modification times
forbidden_mutations: all reports/models_selected artifacts and the 5 protected source files
